description: Applies the reviewer's decision on a No-show follow-up approval form: sends the (possibly edited) message through the practice's own email provider, or leaves the item open with instructions when that provider can't send yet. On a successful send, checks the patient's no-show history and flags the practitioner if this is a repeat (2+ in the same history).
